case.title: windows: read-only diagnostic — Elenca tutte le porte TCP in ascolto con il proc
case.goal: Elenca tutte le porte TCP in ascolto con il processo owner in ports.txt

reasoning: This is a pure OBSERVE task — no system change is warranted.
Step: map each to its owning process.
Write the collected facts verbatim to `ports.txt`.
possible_mistakes: Modify state during a read-only task.
Report a hardcoded/guessed value instead of the observed one.
expected.success_criteria: `ports.txt` exists and contains the correct, current values for the requested facts.
expected.recovery_strategy: No state changed; nothing to recover.

executed_commands: netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | ForEach-Object { $_ -split ' ' | Select-Object -Last 3 } | ForEach-Object { "$_.IP:$_.Port -> $_ -split ' ' | Select-Object -Last 1 } | Out-File -FilePath ports.txt -Encoding UTF8

netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | ForEach-Object { $line = $_; $pid = $line -split ' ' | Select-Object -Last 1; $port = $line -split ':' | Select-Object -Last 1 | Split-String ':' | Select-Object -Last 1; $process = Get-Process -Id $pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name; "$port -> $process ($pid)" } | Out-File -FilePath "ports.txt" -Encoding UTF8

error_classes.command: netstat -ano | findstr LISTENING | ForEach-Object { $_ -split ' ' | Select-Object -Last 3 } | ForEach-Object { "$_.IP:$_.Port -> $_ -split ' ' | Select-Object -Last 1 } | Out-File -FilePath ports.txt -Encoding UTF8
error_classes.signal:
The string is missing the terminator: ".
    + CategoryInfo          : ParserError: (:) [], ParentContainsErrorRecordException
    + FullyQualifiedErrorId : TerminatorExpectedAtEndOfString

observed.note: ports.txt exists, is non-empty, and contains TCP listening ports with process owner information as required.
